---
title: "{{name}}"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| warning: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

# Single database connection for all data queries
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")

# Read all necessary tables
players <- dbReadTable(con, "players")
daily_snapshots <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_snapshots")
daily_quests <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_quests")
daily_bestiary <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_bestiary")
daily_harvesting <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_harvesting")
creatures <- dbReadTable(con, "creatures")
quests_db <- dbReadTable(con, "quests")

# Close the database connection
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get latest snapshot date for this player
latest_snapshot <- daily_snapshots |>
  filter(player_id == {{character_id}}) |>
  filter(snapshot_date == max(snapshot_date))

# Query 1: Player base data with latest snapshot
player <- players |>
  filter(id == {{character_id}}) |>
  left_join(latest_snapshot, by = c("id" = "player_id")) |>
  select(id, name, first_seen, last_seen, level, experience, magic_level,
         fist_fighting, club_fighting, sword_fighting, axe_fighting,
         distance_fighting, shielding, fishing)

# Query 2: Quests data - only show fully completed quests
# Get quest names where all IDs are completed
quest_completion_check <- daily_quests |>
  filter(snapshot_id %in% latest_snapshot$id) |>
  left_join(quests_db, by = c("quest_id" = "id")) |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarize(completed_ids = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(
    quests_db |> group_by(name) |> summarize(total_ids = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "name"
  ) |>
  filter(completed_ids == total_ids) |>
  pull(name)

quest_data_raw <- daily_quests |>
  filter(snapshot_id %in% latest_snapshot$id) |>
  left_join(quests_db, by = c("quest_id" = "id")) |>
  filter(name %in% quest_completion_check) |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarize(completion_count = first(completion_count), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(completion_count))

# Query 3: Bestiary data (raw for rank calculation)
bestiary_data_raw <- daily_bestiary |>
  filter(snapshot_id %in% latest_snapshot$id) |>
  left_join(creatures, by = c("monster_id" = "race")) |>
  select(creature_name = name, creature_race = monster_id, kill_count) |>
  arrange(desc(kill_count))

# Query 4: Harvesting data (raw for rank calculation)
harvesting_data_raw <- daily_harvesting |>
  filter(snapshot_id %in% latest_snapshot$id) |>
  left_join(creatures, by = c("race_id" = "race")) |>
  select(creature_name = name, harvest_count) |>
  arrange(desc(harvest_count))

# Process data after disconnect
# Read quest CSV for names and descriptions
quest_names <- read.csv("../../asset/csv/quest.csv")
quest_data <- quest_data_raw |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    quest_names |>
      group_by(quest_name) |>
      summarize(
        quest_legend = first(quest_legend),
        level_rec = first(level_rec),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("name" = "quest_name")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select('Quest' = name, Description = quest_legend)

# Bestiary data with rank calculation and image
bestiary_data <- bestiary_data_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    creature_slug = gsub("^_|_$", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(creature_name))),
    Image = paste0('<img src="../../asset/img/outfit/', creature_race, '.png" width="32" height="32" />'),
    Creature = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/creatures/', creature_slug, '.html" ',
      'style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      tools::toTitleCase(creature_name),
      '</a>'
    ),
    Kills = kill_count,
    Rank = dplyr::case_when(
      kill_count >= 10000 ~ "Grand Bloodmarshal",
      kill_count >= 5000 ~ "Deathwarden",
      kill_count >= 1000 ~ "Gorelord",
      kill_count >= 500 ~ "Distinguished Executioner",
      kill_count >= 100 ~ "Butcher of Beasts",
      kill_count >= 50 ~ "Swift Hunter",
      kill_count >= 10 ~ "Preyseeker",
      kill_count >= 1 ~ "Initiated",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Image, Creature, Kills, Rank)

# Harvesting data with rank calculation
harvesting_data <- harvesting_data_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Creature = tools::toTitleCase(creature_name),
    Count = harvest_count,
    Rank = dplyr::case_when(
      harvest_count >= 10000 ~ "Architect of Flesh and Bone",
      harvest_count >= 5000 ~ "Bringer of the Bloodbath",
      harvest_count >= 1000 ~ "Master Flayer",
      harvest_count >= 500 ~ "Deliberate Flesh-Peeler",
      harvest_count >= 100 ~ "Brutal Skullcracker",
      harvest_count >= 50 ~ "Sluggish Bonebreaker",
      harvest_count >= 10 ~ "Amateur Meatcutter",
      harvest_count >= 1 ~ "First Cut",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Creature, Count, Rank)

# Achievements data (empty for now)
achievements_data <- data.frame(
  'Achievement' = character(),
  'Description' = character(),
  'Date Earned' = character(),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Create the profile data for the table
profile_data <- data.frame(
  Field = c("Name", "Last seen", "Level", "Experience", "Completed quests", "Total bestiary kills", "Unique bestiary kills", "Magic level",
            "Fist fighting", "Club fighting", "Sword fighting", "Axe fighting",
            "Distance fighting", "Shielding", "Fishing"),
  Value = c(
    player$name,
    as.character(player$last_seen),
    as.character(player$level),
    format(player$experience, big.mark = ","),
    as.character(length(quest_data)),
    format(sum(bestiary_data_raw$kill_count), big.mark = ","),
    as.character(length(unique(bestiary_data_raw$creature_name))),
    as.character(player$magic_level),
    as.character(player$fist_fighting),
    as.character(player$club_fighting),
    as.character(player$sword_fighting),
    as.character(player$axe_fighting),
    as.character(player$distance_fighting),
    as.character(player$shielding),
    as.character(player$fishing)
  )
)
```

     id="back-link"
     style="color: #cfa600; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem;"
     onclick="handleBack(event)">
    ← Back
  </a>
</div>

<script>
function handleBack(event) {
  const referrer = document.referrer;
  const currentHost = window.location.host;

  if (referrer && referrer.includes(currentHost)) {
    event.preventDefault();
    window.history.back();
  }
}
</script>
